people.name: Achaia
people.line: A Roman province in southern Greece, including Corinth.

people.name: Gallio
people.line: Roman proconsul of Achaia; refused to judge Paul.

people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: But when Gallio was proconsul of Achaia, the Jews with one accord rose up against Paul and brought him before the judgment seat,
translations.bsb: While Gallio was proconsul of Achaia, the Jews coordinated an attack on Paul and brought him before the judgment seat.
translations.kjv: And when Gallio was the deputy of Achaia, the Jews made insurrection with one accord against Paul, and brought him to the judgment seat,
translations.asv: But when Gallio was proconsul of Achaia, the Jews with one accord rose up against Paul and brought him before the judgment-seat,
